idea: Basic plumbing maintenance every homeowner should know
title: How to Test for a Hidden Toilet Leak in 10 Minutes
description: A worn toilet flapper can waste hundreds of gallons of water a month without making a sound. Here is a simple, non-destructive test every homeowner can do. Remove your toilet tank lid and add a few drops of dark food coloring directly into the standing water in the cistern. Do not flush. Wait about 15 to 20 minutes. If colored water seeps into the toilet bowl, your flapper or flush valve seal has failed and needs replacement. Catching this early protects your water bill and prevents silent waste. If you notice persistent leaks or aren't comfortable replacing internal tank parts, contact a licensed plumber.
